prompts.name: states-a
prompts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Production 2D fighting game full-body animation sprite sheet for Gustavo, redrawn from references, not a collage. Image1 full-body identity reference; image2 face reference. Preserve exact narrow face, nose, clean-shaven jaw, brown swept-back hair in low ponytail, white laboratory coat, olive T-shirt, blue jeans, brown low sneakers. Classic late-1990s hand-inked arcade cel animation, crisp dark contours, flat colors with two sharply defined shadow tones. No gradients, softness, paint texture, motion blur, 3D, face pasting. Transparent RGBA background, no labels, guides or floor shadows.
Layout: exactly 8 separate full-body cels, 4 columns x 2 rows, wide 2048x1536 image. Every cell uses the SAME orthographic camera and anatomical drawing scale. Standing fighter about 570px high, head about 75px high in EVERY cell including crouch; leave empty space above crouches. Never enlarge bent poses to fill cells. Reference same leg length and head/body ratio all frames. Ground baseline near bottom of each cell. All face right, 3/4 side view, feet entirely visible. Enough spacing, no overlaps.
Read order poses: 0 relaxed kickboxing guard, 1 subtle guard exhale (same head size and height within 6px), 2 standing block forearms shielding face, 3 block recoiling slightly torso back, 4 low crouching guard knees bent deeply (total height about 365px, same 75px head), 5 crouching block (same crouch height and anatomy), 6 jump rising with rear knee bent (airborne, boots lifted, same anatomy), 7 jump apex both knees tucked (total silhouette about 400px, same head size).
Primary quality: consistent adult proportions and identical face every cel; no giant crouching man. Keep source pixel resolution high; draw full new cels with bold clean edges.

prompts.name: smoke-fx
prompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent RGBA sprite sheet of 16 hand-drawn smoke power VFX cels for a 2D arcade fighting game. No character, no face, no text. Classic late-90s crossover arcade cel effects with razor sharp dark teal ink contours, ivory white hot cores, cyan mint smoke bellows, deep indigo/violet under-shadows. Punchy high contrast. These are SMOKE effects, not fireballs, not lightning, not water. Sculpted billowing curls, sharp speed wedges, expressive hand-painted CEL ANIMATION with only 3 solid shadow tones, no blurry glow or airbrush.
Layout 4 columns x 4 rows in a large 2048x2048 sheet, transparent gutters, no overlap. Every effect fully contained within its cell.
Row1: 4 successive loop frames of a right-traveling compressed smoke wave, frontal round rolling cloud core on the RIGHT, long sharply tapered curling smoke ribbon trailing LEFT, dense volume at core; consistent core position at cell x=350,y=256. Core about 110px diameter, tail200px, whole effect about350x190px.
Row2: 4 successive one-shot contact frames, from compressed white jagged impact spark with short mint smoke collar, to dramatic expanding radial smoke explosion, to curling breakup wisps, to fading separated curl fragments. Impact epicenter cell center.
Row3: 4 successive uppercut rising SMOKE CRESCENT frames, curved white/mint sweep rising from bottom left to top right, core following a curved arc, huge bold dark teal outside and bright inside. A crescent roughly230px wide and400px tall. Clear silhouette, visible open inside, not a full opaque cloud.
Row4: 4 successive gathering/releasing palm smoke frames, first tight curl spiral (90px), second compressed 140px coil, third sharp explosive outward fan pointing RIGHT (280px), fourth separated curling wisps (260px). Same center, size intentionally evolves.
Preserve crisp linework and transparent alpha, no checkerboard printed, no floor, no rectangular backgrounds, no ground shadows.
